doc.title: Alan Broadbent interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 26, 2023

title: Falling toward the stage machinery in Tokyo
summary: A story of a Woody Herman concert at a Tokyo club with movable stages, where he nearly fell into the machinery below.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: I see. I think I read something in this Woody Herman book that you actually fell into a hole in Japan on some Woody Herman concert?

Yeah, yeah, yeah. That was a real thing. Well that’s another story. No there was this gentlemen’s club that we played somewhere in Tokyo, I don’t know, but it had movable stages, like this you know. So the Japanese Benny Goodman band was here performing and we were under here waiting. Then we came up, like this, and we played our set. And anyway that’s how I grabbed myself instead of falling into all the chains and gears below. So anyway. Long story short.
